profile: default release for allocation/codegen; x11,wayland for native and strict Clippy
source_note: Final release rebuild followed all production edits. The final source commit also includes one later cfg(test)-only old-map reference test; it cannot affect either release artifact. The first dependency build overlapping edits is not an authoritative artifact.
